rubric_intent: Score this document on engineering substance.

dimensions.name: Technical Depth
dimensions.description: Measures the extent to which the document delves into specific technical details, algorithms, or architectural choices.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Look for detailed explanations of technical concepts, code snippets, data structures, or system designs. Assess the level of specificity and rigor in these explanations.

dimensions.name: Problem Definition Clarity
dimensions.description: Evaluates how clearly and precisely the engineering problem or challenge being addressed is articulated.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Examine the introduction and problem statement sections. Assess if the scope, constraints, and desired outcomes of the problem are unambiguously defined.

dimensions.name: Solution Rationale
dimensions.description: Assesses the justification provided for the chosen engineering approach or solution.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Review sections discussing proposed solutions, design choices, or implementation strategies. Look for explanations of why a particular approach was selected over alternatives, supported by technical reasoning.

dimensions.name: Completeness of Scope
dimensions.description: Determines if the document covers all essential aspects of the engineering problem and its proposed solution.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Scan the document for sections addressing requirements, design, implementation considerations, testing, and potential future work. Assess if any critical engineering areas appear to be omitted.

dimensions.name: Technical Feasibility
dimensions.description: Measures the perceived practicality and achievability of the proposed engineering solutions within realistic constraints.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Examine the proposed solutions and implementation plans. Look for discussions of resource requirements, potential risks, and whether the proposed work aligns with known technological capabilities.

dimensions.name: Use of Engineering Terminology
dimensions.description: Evaluates the appropriate and accurate use of industry-standard engineering terms and concepts.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Read through the document, paying attention to the language used. Assess if technical terms are used correctly and if the overall vocabulary reflects an understanding of the engineering domain.
